XOVI and reMarkable XOVI extensions
==================================

reMarkable Mirror redistributes the unmodified upstream
`xovi-aarch64.tar.gz` release artifact named below. Mirror's installer selects
the upstream framebuffer-spy and xovi-message-broker extensions from that
archive and also installs the Mirror-owned rmmirror-files-loopback extension.
XOVI remains tethered: it is never configured to start at boot.

Release: rm-xovi-extensions v19-23052026
Release commit: 7874154dba6793cc68a15fae0fb9dd272c4ed20a
Archive SHA-256: 32d64d1262ddc984e3235c7d0340a398fe6d5b3efa6a979865f5977b32630d27
Release source: https://github.com/asivery/rm-xovi-extensions/tree/7874154dba6793cc68a15fae0fb9dd272c4ed20a
Release artifact: https://github.com/asivery/rm-xovi-extensions/releases/tag/v19-23052026
License: GNU GPL v3; see LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt.

The archive's `xovi.so` is the unmodified XOVI v0.3.3 aarch64 release asset.

XOVI release: v0.3.3
XOVI commit: 0c8d5269b55c851901d4e4a754dc2d7deab40b17
xovi.so SHA-256: d4df820c25c634c511de11067279d8310fa4f656dc52bd4540db6beac4ffd446
XOVI source: https://github.com/asivery/xovi/tree/0c8d5269b55c851901d4e4a754dc2d7deab40b17
License at this exact release commit: GNU GPL v3; see LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt.

No source inside the redistributed upstream archive was modified. The
corresponding upstream source remains available at the exact public commit links
above.

rmmirror-files-loopback is a GPL-3.0-only Mirror-owned extension derived from
the native address-selection hooks in upstream webserver-remote. Its source is
at mirror/agent/xovi/rmmirror-files-loopback/ in this repository. The full GNU
GPL version 3 license is supplied as LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt.

reMarkable Mirror is an independent project and is not affiliated with the
upstream XOVI authors.
